title.zh: 后得来源关系接通保留记录的绑定
title.en: Later source learning binds retained records

claim.zh: 经一族解释读记录：对每类记录、意义与世界，每条关涉记录都被某个以目标为目标的族内世界解释时，形式解析为目标，恰当不重复候选范围中的其他每个意义，都被某条没有带该意义的族内世界能解释的关涉记录排除。对经取得的来源路径重读的旧命名记录：保留包的记录恰提供以已学路线、被允许扰动产生其报告的世界之原子；对每个记忆、扰动范围、形式与目标，若该形式的每个包都由某个以目标为目标的已学世界产生，绑定视图把形式解析为目标，恰当其他每个意义都被该形式的某个包排除，而没有以该意义为目标的已学世界产生此包；此时唯一绑定正确（既有的覆盖定理由此对每个记录得出）。先命名后校准的经历（retrospective 36）是实例：其两个保留包分离两个原子，故每个有限编码序列的解释是其原子的组合。后期真实路线改变后，较早的包不由任何以其目标为目标的已学世界产生，是失败一侧；另有有限响应见证。
claim.en: Records read through a family of explanations: for every type of records, meanings and worlds, where each bearing record is explained by some family world with the target, a form resolves to the target exactly when every other meaning of a repertoire without repeats is ruled out by some bearing record that no family world with that meaning explains. For earlier naming records reread through acquired production routes: a retained packet’s record offers exactly the atoms of the worlds, a learned route under an admitted fault, that produce its reports; for every memory, fault envelope, form and target whose packets of the form are each produced by some learned world with the target, the binding view resolves the form to the target exactly when every other meaning is ruled out by some packet of the form that no learned world with that meaning produces, and unique binding is then correct (the existing coverage theorem follows for every record). The naming-before-calibration history (retrospective 36) is an instance: its two retained packets separate both atoms, so every finite encoded sequence is interpreted as the assembly of its atoms. After a later real route change the earlier packet is produced by no learned world with its target, the failing side; a finite response has a separate witness.

hypotheses.zh: 已有分节、原子操作、形式识别、渠道身份和报道符号解码已具备；四种路径、校准探测和扰动范围公开给定。
hypotheses.en: Grouping, atomic operations, form recognition, channel identity and reporting-symbol decoding are available; the four-route family, calibration probes and fault envelope are explicitly supplied.

hypotheses.zh: 一般正确性要求校准记录来自声明路径，且该路径覆盖每个相关早先命名记录；各记录的实际扰动在声明范围内。历史适用性不是学习器的已知答案。
hypotheses.en: General correctness requires calibration from the declared route and that same route to cover each relevant earlier naming record, with its actual disturbance admitted. Historical applicability is not a known answer supplied to the learner.

hypotheses.zh: 局部见证保留原分节与组合训练，接收和校准各消耗支持；报道解码器的已有训练成本未新接入，计算和存储维护不另收费。
hypotheses.en: The local witness retains prior grouping/composition training and charges reception/calibration. Previously formed reporting-decoder training costs are not newly joined; computation and storage maintenance receive no separate charge.

correspondence.zh: 记录内容保留而当前证据作用可改变。实际路线及新词目标不输入bindingView。控制探测不是儿童熟悉命名的同一操作；心理实现、来源身份形成、时间范围及演化起源仍需对应。
correspondence.en: Record contents persist while their current evidential role can change. bindingView receives neither the actual route nor the novel target. Controlled probes are not identical to children’s familiar naming; psychological realization, source-identity formation, temporal scope and evolutionary origin need further correspondence.

detail.zh: acquired_routes_supply_binding_coverage直接调用既有唯一绑定覆盖定理；取得的绑定再进入既有readForms、interpret和execute。
detail.en: acquired_routes_supply_binding_coverage directly invokes the existing unique-binding coverage theorem; acquired bindings enter the existing readForms, interpret and execute.

output.zh: 来源候选与旧报告相容的原子内容包含实际目标。
output.en: Atomic contents compatible with acquired route candidates and old reports contain the actual target.

input.zh: 既有绑定正确性定理要求每个相关记录覆盖目标。
input.en: The existing binding-correctness theorem requires target coverage for each relevant record.

conditions.zh: 实际路径在校准取得范围，扰动受覆盖，路径向过去的适用性明示，目标在原子操作范围。
conditions.en: Actual route retained by calibration, disturbance covered, backward route applicability explicit, target in the atomic repertoire.

detail.zh: 复用选择不自动产生保留优势的经验约束；无数据到Lean状态的已验证转换。
detail.en: Reuses the empirical limit on automatic control-to-retention advantage; no verified conversion from data to Lean states.

detail.zh: 缺记录、部分校准、渠道错置、有限支持及继承的遗漏联合作用分别保留失败；真实路径改变使准确晚期校准仍可误解早先内容。
detail.en: Missing packets, partial calibration, channel misindexing, finite support and the inherited omitted joint effect preserve distinct failures; a real route change allows accurate late calibration to misinterpret earlier content.

limitations.zh: 不证明全部来源判断、自然语言、发育机制、完整能量账、意识或演化心理；没有把既有移动选择与社会报告生产再组合为同一史，也不认定儿童使用此算法。
limitations.en: Does not prove all source judgments, natural language, developmental mechanism, complete energy accounting, consciousness or evolutionary psychology. It does not additionally compose prior movement selection with social report production into one history or identify this algorithm in children.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1：20项新定理／36项声明审计，284项继承定理／513项审计分列；新11空依赖、10仅propext、15含propext和Quot.sound。继承闭包含Classical.choice。原典比较与作者反审，无新经验复算或独立agent验收。
validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1: 20 new theorems / 36 declaration audits; 284 inherited theorems / 513 audits separately rebuilt. New dependencies: 11 empty, 10 propext only, 15 propext with Quot.sound. Inherited closure includes Classical.choice. Primary-source comparison and author counterreview; no new empirical reanalysis or independent-agent acceptance.

next_delta.zh: 既有条件连接保留；下一重点是在匹配发育程序中识别已取得访问及所保留来源／次序如何进入实际使用，分别观察当前依赖与旧内容认可。原典已约束自动迁移，但未识别唯一机制或演化史。
next_delta.en: Preserve the completed conditional connections. Next identify how formed access and retained source/order information guide actual use in a matched developmental procedure, distinguishing present reliance from old-content endorsement. Primary evidence constrains automatic transfer without identifying a unique mechanism or evolutionary history.

history.en: 14 October 2026, open-issues plan (study section 117): the claim now states the law first. New core module Becoming.CrossSituational: the law of records read through a family of explanations (resolves_explained_iff); the periphery MachineInstances: for every memory, fault envelope, form and target, the binding view resolves to the target exactly when every rival is ruled out by a packet no learned world with the rival produces (retrospective_resolves_iff); the coverage theorem follows from the law (coverage_from_law), retrospective 36 is an instance, and after a real route change the target is not produced (changed_route_unproduced). Built with scratch_build: core axiom reports empty, the periphery with standard axioms only; the proof binding to MachineInstances still names the earlier run and is repointed at landing. The original theorems and counterexamples are unchanged.
